source.title: Hessen Kerncurriculum gymnasiale Oberstufe Biologie, Ausgabe 2024
source.bindingNote: The official Q1.2 lists histone acetylation/methylation and RNA interference at elevated LK level; Q1.3 lists analysis of monohybrid autosomal/sex-linked dominant/recessive family pedigrees at GK/LK level. Genetic testing and counselling are a separate Q1.3 item. The source extraction has more specific goal wording and is not treated as a verbatim quote from the PDF.

records.finding: The 360 px and 680 px views retain the open/dense chromatin contrast, nucleosomes, tail marks and legible labels. The marks are intentionally not assigned a universal activation direction. The revised data-analysis target and alt text supply the context that the image cannot prove.

mRNA and siRNA labels, guide/target pairing, cleavage and reduced protein output remain distinguishable at both widths. This depicts one siRNA/Ago2 route only; the revised target asks for one supplied RNAi example and does not claim every RNAi pathway or a treatment outcome.

The opaque three-child pedigree has visible conventional connectors and affected/unaffected symbols at 360 px and 680 px. It cannot determine a unique mode of inheritance from this small family. The current alt text now says that explicitly and no longer suggests individual risk assessment.

outcome: Exact active image bytes stayed unchanged; goal wording, one alt text, and targeted current Kind/A/M/V bindings were reviewed and updated.
